how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-feralas-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:3567:title: To the Top
rows.quest:3567:completion:0: Would you like to see the view atop one of the twin colossals? I can send you there, ⟦1⟧.⟦2⟧⟦3⟧Do consider how you will get down, though. This is a one way trip only.
rows.quest:7735:title: ⟦E1⟧
rows.quest:7735:progress:0: What's this, ⟦4⟧ - you've got something special for me?
rows.quest:7735:completion:0: Incredible!  You may have found the granddaddy of all yeti hides with this!⟦5⟧⟦6⟧You better believe I'll pay you for it.  I normally don't pay that much for a single hide, but I'm pretty sure I can make something special from it.  Thanks for thinking of me on this, ⟦7⟧!
rows.quest:7738:title: ⟦E5⟧
rows.quest:7738:progress:0: What's this, ⟦8⟧ - you've got something special for me?
rows.quest:7738:completion:0: This is an incredible find! I believe this is the finest yeti hide specimen I have ever seen!⟦9⟧⟦10⟧Indeed, this is certainly worthy of an appropriate bounty. I normally don't pay that much for a single hide, but I'm confident I can make something special from it. Thanks for thinking of me on this, ⟦11⟧!
rows.quest:2862:obj:0: Bring 10 Woodpaw Gnoll Manes to ⟦E8⟧ in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:2862:details:0: The gnolls... they are more than a nuisance. They are a constant threat to the existence of this very camp! It is irrelevant whether they are indigenous to ⟦E4⟧ or not; if we do not strengthen our resolve against them, we will find ourselves driven out of the entire region.
rows.quest:2862:details:1: The gnoll attacks against the camp have become more fevered as of late. We need your aid in thinning their numbers; bring to me ten of their manes, and I will reward you handsomely for your effort.
rows.quest:2862:progress:0: We drive them back, and yet they still attack! Someone or something must be driving them into a frenzy... oh, you have returned, eh ⟦12⟧? Do you have the manes I require for the bounty to be met?
rows.quest:2862:completion:0: This is proof of a good start, ⟦13⟧. Your skills as a soldier are to be commended.
rows.quest:2862:completion:1: You are not the only one I ask that task of. Many before you have fought them, and in times past our efforts have kept them at bay. Recently though, their attempts to push northward into our area of influence have increased dramatically. Their attacks have also become more savage... almost as if they were desperate.
rows.quest:2862:completion:2: I have a plan though, ⟦14⟧, that might settle things once and for all against them...
rows.quest:2863:obj:0: Kill 5 Woodpaw Alphas and return to ⟦E8⟧ within one hour.
rows.quest:2863:details:0: The plan is for various leaders of the gnolls - Alphas as they call themselves - to be taken down within rapid succession. If we're able to execute this sort of swift and precise devastation against them, it would cause chaos in their ranks. Perhaps it would also drive a message through their thick flea-bitten heads that we can and will destroy them!
rows.quest:2863:details:1: I want you to be the messenger of my will; eliminate five of their Alphas within one hour for this to work ⟦15⟧, or we'll remain at this impasse!
rows.quest:2863:progress:0: Time is running out, ⟦16⟧! If you're not here to report that you've taken out the Alphas, then you're wasting time!
rows.quest:2863:completion:0: You've done as I have asked, and for that I salute you. Take this small reward as compensation for your efforts, ⟦17⟧.
rows.quest:2863:completion:1: With their numbers thinned and their leaders slain, the gnolls will think twice about storming the camp. This doesn't conclude the issue at hand, however...
rows.quest:2863:completion:2: There must be some reason why the gnolls have been whipped into such a frenzied state. Before they have a chance to regroup though, I want to find out what is causing it.
rows.quest:2866:obj:0: Explore the Ruins of Solarsal and investigate the presence of the naga there.
rows.quest:2866:details:0: To our south are the Ruins of Solarsal; this is an area that far pre-dates modern times. We explored the ruins initially and found nothing of note; as such, we left it in peace.
rows.quest:2866:details:1: Very recently, the Hatecrest naga have occupied these ruins in alarming numbers. At first, we considered it as the precursor for an attack. Though that threat is still possible, we believe there might be something else going on.
rows.quest:2866:details:2: Go there, explore the ruins, and look for anything that stands out to you. Good luck, ⟦18⟧.
rows.quest:2866:completion:0: Examining the gazebo reveals some interesting and unusual things in contrast to the surrounding ruins.
rows.quest:2866:completion:1: First, the gazebo is clearly a more recent construction than the other objects in the ruins. Second, the gazebo has a small series of glyphs engraved into the sides of it; the glyphs repeat in their pattern, but it otherwise is unknown in origin and meaning. Third, the stone of the gazebo itself is warm to the touch.
rows.quest:2866:completion:2: This certainly quantifies as "standing out" in the search of the ruins!
rows.quest:2867:obj:0: Return to ⟦E11⟧ in the ⟦E3⟧ and report your findings.
rows.quest:2867:details:0: With the discovery of the strange gazebo in the heart of the Ruins of Solarsal, the time has come to return to ⟦E3⟧ and report to General ⟦E11⟧ what has been discovered here.
rows.quest:2867:completion:0: Welcome back, ⟦19⟧. Your report on this gazebo is most... disturbing. It would seem that even if the naga there were not planning on an attack, their continued presence bodes ill for our push into ⟦E4⟧. At any rate, here is compensation for your investigation.
rows.quest:2867:completion:1: It would seem that ⟦E3⟧ is in dire need of additional assistance concerning the Hatecrest naga. I'd like to offer you the task, if you are so inclined. There is much to do.
rows.quest:2869:obj:0: Bring 10 Hatecrest Naga Scales to ⟦E12⟧ in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:2869:details:0: The best course of action at this point is to assume that, regardless of what the naga are up to, they will eventually move to secure the island for their own. We need to take aggressive steps to counter that threat before it is too late.
rows.quest:2869:details:1: Bring me ten Hatecrest Scales that are in good condition; it should be obvious to you how to acquire them. You'll cut your teeth on the naga for the first time, and we'll have a weakened naga presence on Sardor Isle - both are prospects that play to our advantage.
rows.quest:2869:progress:0: ⟦20⟧, if you're here to verify the task given to you, then excellent - it is ten Hatecrest scales I seek.  If you are here for chit-chat, then I am currently unavailable for such trivialities.⟦21⟧⟦22⟧Know this - we night elves are not warmongers.  Our race is dedicated to the preservation of peace and harmony.  This does not mean, however, that we will not proactively protect our own interests.  This is my duty to General Feathermoon, and to the stronghold.
rows.quest:2869:completion:0: Yes, yes, these scales are more than satisfactory. Actually, I think I will send these down to Pratt for him to take a look at. Maybe he can craft something useful out of them.
rows.quest:2869:completion:1: As for you, I have another mission I want to send you on. But first, here is your bounty for the scales. Your continued service to the General and ⟦E3⟧ at large is a blessing in the face of adversity.
rows.quest:2902:obj:0: Find the gnoll battle plans somewhere in the gnoll camps to the south of ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:2902:details:0: Gnolls aren't the sharpest tools in the shed, but they will no doubt have some sort of documented strategy on their recent activity. If we were to find those plans, then we'd have a clearer idea of what is making them so worked up.
rows.quest:2902:details:1: I want you to head back to the Woodpaw and find anything that might resemble their battle plans. They have to have something; their attacks have been too coordinated to be done without them. Find them, and return to me when you have them.
rows.quest:2902:completion:0: Examining the map reveals it to be the battle plans that ⟦E8⟧ wants. Numerous arrows that perhaps represent troop movements are drawn on the map, though most seem to be headed toward the south rather than to the north where ⟦E7⟧ lies.
rows.quest:2902:completion:1: Another section of the map has a picture of what you think is a large insect of some kind, with various tick marks under it. From the looks of the gnolls, it perhaps represents their losses against the unknown bugs...
rows.quest:2903:details:0: With the battle plans of the gnolls discovered, all that now remains is to bring the plans back to ⟦E8⟧ in ⟦E7⟧. Perhaps he or someone there can make further sense of what the gnolls are up to.
rows.quest:2903:progress:0: Welcome back ⟦23⟧ - were you able to find some tangible evidence as to the plans of the gnolls?
rows.quest:2903:completion:0: Ah, this is exactly what we needed. While I am not so skilled at ciphering what most of the scrawling on this map is, I've seen enough battle plans in my day to understand what is happening with the gnolls. It looks like they are currently fighting a two front war. One is with us... but it seems that their main energy has been against a foe to their south.
rows.quest:2903:completion:1: There's more at hand here than meets the eye. Perhaps it is time to figure out who this other foe they face really is.
rows.quest:2975:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ in ⟦E7⟧ wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Ogres, 10 ⟦E17⟧-Magi, and 5 Gordunni Brutes.
rows.quest:2975:details:0: The effects of the ⟦E17⟧ tribe can hardly go unnoticed in this area. Look around, ⟦24⟧; their very presence scars this land. We must push them back before they expand even further into ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:2975:details:1: Follow the river north, and you will find their outpost. Decrease their numbers, ⟦25⟧. We must show them that their kind is not wanted here.
rows.quest:2975:progress:0: Move swiftly, ⟦26⟧. Or is the task I requested too difficult?
rows.quest:2975:completion:0: Excellent, ⟦27⟧. In time, the land will heal. We must not give up.
rows.quest:2978:details:0: Picking up the soiled scroll, you notice that it seems to be depicting some sort of meeting or ceremony. ⟦E16⟧ would be interested in this scroll, and what it might mean to the Gordunni.
rows.quest:2978:completion:0: This scroll... You found this in the Gordunni Outpost?
rows.quest:2987:details:0: I just arrived here in ⟦E4⟧, and I've heard that the Gordunni Ogres that inhabit the wilds here have some interesting minerals. Who knows what they are up to, but they sure are protective of that stuff! They don't leave it just lying around; no, they bury it to protect folks like me from getting their hands on it.
rows.quest:2987:details:1: If you'd be willing, I'll give you my shovel. Go to the Gordunni Outpost north of here and dig me up some Gordunni cobalt. Look for the blue glow, then start digging!
rows.quest:2987:progress:0: Get on up there and start digging!⟦28⟧⟦29⟧I've got places to go and people to see -- time is money!
rows.quest:2987:completion:0: Perfect! I will take these along as I continue my travels, ⟦30⟧. I'm sure I can find someone that will pay a pretty penny for this cobalt.
rows.quest:2987:completion:1: Here, take this for your trouble.
rows.quest:3130:details:0: At this point, I am going to direct you to my second, Latronicus. He's been keeping a close eye on the naga forces to date. I'll assess the general situation here in regards to the naga; as much as I want to commit a full force to move against them, leaving the stronghold open to direct attack from the ⟦E22⟧ - or worse - seems less than optimal.
rows.quest:3130:details:1: Anyway, Latronicus awaits. Good work thus far, ⟦31⟧. Keep it up.
rows.quest:3130:completion:0: Excellent, ⟦32⟧ - I value a "can do" attitude in those who I work with.
rows.quest:3130:completion:1: I've been tasked by General Feathermoon to address the naga in a direct manner. My plans are two fold: one, we will weaken their forces both in number and in command, and two, we will uncover what they are up to in the ruins. With your help, we'll counter the naga presence without sacrificing the general security of the stronghold.
rows.quest:4124:details:0: An associate of mine, ⟦E23⟧, is looking for assistance concerning the location of a courier and the parcels he was carrying. It has been a week or so since the courier went missing; our own searches have proved fruitless, and we're at an impasse. Unfortunately, I have had to declare the courier as missing in action.
rows.quest:4124:details:1: If you have the time and resources to spare, please speak with Ginro. He should be here in the Stronghold - perhaps in his quarters.
rows.quest:4124:completion:0: Latro sent you to me, I presume. While I think it is a lost cause at this point, I'll take whatever assistance you can offer. I must admit... I'll be glad once I can put my mind to rest on this matter. Every day I set out into the wilds of ⟦E4⟧ looking for signs of Raschal, and every night I have come back with nothing to show for my work save gnoll teeth and disappointment.
rows.quest:4125:obj:0: Locate the courier's boat somewhere along the coast of ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:4125:details:0: It's been about a week since Raschal, the courier, set out for Thalanaar. He knows ⟦E4⟧ well; he's been with us since General Feathermoon led the expeditionary forces here. I know his plan was to take a row boat down the coast and try and traverse across southern ⟦E4⟧ to avoid the ⟦E22⟧ camp.
rows.quest:4125:details:1: I couldn't find his boat, but maybe you can. Maybe it is hidden, or maybe it was sunk. Regardless, it might hold a clue as to where he is. If you uncover something, please let me know.
rows.quest:4125:completion:0: You have found what appears to be a wrecked row boat. Through the slightly muddy water you see gaping holes riddling the port side; the boat is nearly shredded down to its simple wooden frame. Whatever broke this boat most likely tried to snap it in two. A small crest of the ⟦E3⟧ is painted on the starboard side.
rows.quest:4125:completion:1: In the mud at the base of the boat, a glint of something metallic catches your eye...
rows.quest:2980:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ in ⟦E7⟧ wants you to kill 10 ⟦E24⟧, 10 Gordunni Warlocks, and 5 Gordunni Maulers.
rows.quest:2980:details:0: Now that you have proven that you are a true fighter, I trust that you possess the courage to continue with the task at hand.
rows.quest:2980:details:1: ⟦E25⟧ to the High Wilderness, southwest of here. There lie some abandoned and destroyed structures, on land that once belonged to the night elves. Look for these ruins, and when you see the withered trees and desecrated terrain, you will find the Gordunni. Push them back.
rows.quest:2980:details:2: These ogres are much stronger than the ones you faced previously, ⟦33⟧. Be aware.
rows.quest:2980:completion:0: You have proven yourself to be a trustworthy and dependable ally, ⟦35⟧.
rows.quest:2982:obj:0: ⟦E26⟧ wants you to kill 8 Gordunni Warlocks, 8 ⟦E24⟧, and 8 Gordunni Brutes.
rows.quest:2982:details:0: Although it is dangerous, Troyas and I have been investigating the ruins that cover the forests of ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:2982:details:1: Lately, though, Troyas has been going on his own to the High Wilderness, and I really worry about him. The Gordunni Ogres have taken over that area, and they don't take kindly to anyone that enters their territory.
rows.quest:2982:details:2: I was hoping you might be willing to travel to the ruins to the southeast and clear out some of the ogres. Make it a little safer for my Troyas, and I will be extremely grateful.
rows.quest:2982:progress:0: Be watchful around the Gordunni, ⟦36⟧. Their magic seems to wreak havoc on the very land they stand on.
rows.quest:2982:completion:0: I am very grateful you were able to do this for me.
rows.quest:2982:completion:1: Now, please, don't mention a word to Troyas about this...
rows.quest:4127:obj:0: ⟦E27⟧ and show ⟦E23⟧ the ⟦E28⟧ you have found.
rows.quest:4127:details:0: Running your hand along the mud, your fingers graze the handle of a knife. It looks well cared for, and it might be safe to assume that whoever was on the boat might have lost it. Perhaps the large chunk of the missing boat might have something to do with the loss.
rows.quest:4127:details:1: You grab the knife, remembering that ⟦E23⟧ in the ⟦E3⟧ instructed you to return to him with any found clues. You get the feeling, however, that you are not quite alone in the water...
rows.quest:4127:progress:0: Ah, welcome back ⟦37⟧.  I hope that you were able to uncover some clue as to Raschal's ultimate fate, as tragic as that may be.
rows.quest:4127:completion:0: Interesting... I believe that this is Raschal's knife. You say you found it at the bottom of the water, along with his boat? Well, just the knife's discovery might not be enough to connect this to Raschal's disappearance; we do, however, have an unconventional option available to us to try and learn more.
rows.quest:4127:completion:1: Have you ever heard of psychometry?
rows.quest:4129:details:0: The Stronghold's resident druid, ⟦E29⟧, has some... unusual skills. One of them involves psychometry - the ability to reveal an item's history by touch. Don't ask me how he does it; I chalk it up to magic I do not and choose not to understand. I do know, however, two things: one, I've seen it work and two, the bum owes me.
rows.quest:4129:details:1: Take the knife up to Quint in his little tree-house here, and tell him for me that his ⟦E31⟧ Hold 'Em debt will be paid if he works his mojo on that knife.
rows.quest:4129:progress:0: Ginro sent you, eh?⟦38⟧⟦39⟧My psychometric readings are fairly draining on the psyche... but so are my losses at ⟦E31⟧ Hold 'Em.  They call me "King of the Bad Beats" here in the Stronghold.  Unlucky at cards... lucky at mastering the secrets of nature, I guess.⟦40⟧⟦41⟧Anyway, of course I'll do it.  This may be just the breakthrough we need to uncover Raschal's fate.  If you would hand me the knife, we can get started.
rows.quest:4129:completion:1: While psychometry isn't an exact art by any stretch of the imagination, I've used it in times past to give insight into situations that others have chalked up to lost causes. I think using it on the knife you've uncovered will give us a glimpse into what happened to Raschal.
rows.quest:4129:completion:2: It will only take a moment to do, but it isn't what I'd call a caster-friendly task. Bear with me on this.
rows.quest:4130:details:0: I'm a little wobbly still, sorry. Anyway, I received some useful visions.
rows.quest:4130:details:1: Raschal takes two large leather backpacks from his boat and goes inland; he returns to the boat, however. I see gnoll scalps... he ran into some gnolls - Woodpaw I think they're called. He's very worried - almost terrified - about something. So much so, that he is not paying attention to water elementals forming behind him. The images... stop there.
rows.quest:4130:details:2: I need to rest, sorry ⟦43⟧. Tell Gin what I've seen. He needs to know.
rows.quest:4130:completion:0: Thanks for passing along Quint's visions to me, ⟦44⟧. I'll try to remember to be a little easier on him the next time we play cards.
rows.quest:4130:completion:1: Raschal can hold his own in a fight, and gnolls aren't anything that would get him worried - nay, terrified. Still, maybe you and yours can act on this new information and make the breakthrough we desperately need.
rows.quest:4131:obj:0: Search the Woodpaw Gnoll camps of southern ⟦E4⟧ for evidence of the courier's belongings or the courier himself.
rows.quest:4131:details:0: Our "friends" the Woodpaw might have gotten Raschal in the end, but something tells me that's not what occurred. Still, they're the best place to start looking.
rows.quest:4131:details:1: I wish I had clearer insight as to what to do, but all I have right now is 'Search the Woodpaw camps - go.' I do know that gnolls will keep items they scavenge and fight over them; maybe they ran across the backpacks Quint mentioned. I hadn't risked a head-on fight in past searches, but with Quint's vision on this I say rip into them.
rows.quest:4131:completion:0: Tacked up on a nearby tree are two large leather backpacks. Each bears a small insignia of the ⟦E3⟧ on the front of the pack...
rows.quest:4281:details:0: This parcel of goods you found in the Woodpaw gnoll camps was supposed to be delivered to the small way-station of Thalanaar in southeastern ⟦E4⟧. Regardless of the missing courier's fate, the task of delivering the parcel remains unfinished.
rows.quest:4281:details:1: Examining the parcel in detail reveals a hand written name of "⟦E36⟧" on the outside of the packaging. Perhaps this is the parcel's ultimate recipient.
rows.quest:4281:progress:0: Welcome to Thalanaar, ⟦45⟧. Do you need assistance of some sort?
rows.quest:4281:completion:0: ⟦E37⟧ be praised, the delivery from ⟦E3⟧ has finally arrived!
rows.quest:4281:completion:1: Your presence here indicates to me that perhaps some ill fate may have befallen Raschal, our usual courier. I hope that everything works out. I know that recently, the Woodpaw have become highly agitated from some source to their south. Maybe he fell to the wilds there; I would be careful, friend.
rows.quest:4281:completion:2: Regardless, thank you again. Here is payment for this parcel's delivery.
rows.quest:2766:obj:0: Take the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot in a cave near ⟦E38⟧ Scar Vale.
rows.quest:2766:details:0: You have uncovered some sort of strange, egg-shaped device made from metal. Fiddling with one of its knobs springs the egg to life, as it opens up into some sort of gnomish robotic contraption! A voice from inside the robotic egg crackles to life.
rows.quest:2766:details:1: B"My name's ⟦E39⟧, and my homing robot has crashed! I will reward you for its recovery; please take this beacon to the robot!"
rows.quest:2766:details:2: B"I now have computed the coordinates of the robot for you; it is in a cave near ⟦E38⟧ Scar Vale!"
rows.quest:2766:progress:0: You appear to have uncovered the wreckage of... a robotic chicken? The voice from within the egg crackles to life again:⟦46⟧⟦47⟧"Yes, excellent work! This is indeed my homing robot, though my sensors indicate that it needs a jump start before it can fly back to ⟦E40⟧ for repairs. Go ahead and place the beacon inside the rover - the beacon will take care of the rest!"
rows.quest:2766:completion:0: You place the egg... distress beacon... inside the chicken... homing robot.
rows.quest:2766:completion:1: Hums and whirs are heard from inside the robot as it struggles to stand up. After the robot comes to life, Oglethorpe's voice is heard once more, but now from inside the robot:
rows.quest:2766:completion:2: B"OOX-22/FE is working at least, but it needs major repairs! It is much too heavy for you to carry it... but I think I have an idea. Are you up for watching over it some more?"
rows.quest:2767:obj:0: Escort OOX-22/FE to the dock along the Forgotten Coast, then report to ⟦E39⟧ in ⟦E40⟧.
rows.quest:2767:details:0: The gnome's voice crackles once again from the robot:
rows.quest:2767:details:1: B"I need to move OOX-22/FE to an open, safe place so it can begin a lengthy take-off procedure. It has built-in cloaking, but I need time on my end to make it operational again. Escort the robot from its current location to, let's say, the dock along the Forgotten Coast! That should be a perfect place, and long enough, to get things online!"
rows.quest:2767:details:2: B"Escort it safely to the dock, and then come talk to me in ⟦E40⟧! ⟦E39⟧ - out!"
rows.quest:2767:progress:0: Yes, I'm ⟦E39⟧, master inventor at your service! Now, is there something I could assist you with?
rows.quest:2767:completion:0: Oh, YOU'RE the great savior of OOX-22/FE! I cannot even begin to express my thanks for your assistance! My homing robot series needs more development, but your recovery has saved me countless hours of extra rebuilding time, as well as many gold pieces in manufacture costs!
rows.quest:2767:completion:1: Please, take your choice of any of these items I have. Thank you again for your generous assistance ⟦48⟧, my robots and I are in your debt!
rows.quest:2870:obj:0: Eliminate ⟦E41⟧, and then bring the ⟦E42⟧ he uncovered to ⟦E12⟧ in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:2870:details:0: ⟦49⟧, new scouting reports have given us a good idea on the naga chain of command. Royalty is present amongst their rank and file, and they're the ones calling all the shots.
rows.quest:2870:details:1: Specifically, we've identified one of the crueler royals as ⟦E41⟧. Scouts report that he himself has uncovered an odd relic during a recent naga excavation in a cave south of the main ruins, across the water on the Isle of Dread.
rows.quest:2870:details:2: Put a stop to it by putting a stop to him, and bring me his relic so we can study it.
rows.quest:2870:progress:0: Bringing down ⟦E41⟧ would certainly set their plans back weeks, if not months.  On top of that, the relic he uncovered is of definite interest to us.⟦50⟧⟦51⟧Have you performed the mission given to you, ⟦52⟧?
rows.quest:2870:completion:0: Well played, ⟦53⟧! ⟦E41⟧'s demise will throw the naga into disarray for some time, if not permanently. The threat they pose is now under more of our control than it has ever been, and we have you to thank for it.
